name: hr_shift
summary: Work shifts, rotating rosters, attendance exceptions, corrections and overtime
description: Adds configurable work shifts (start/end, grace windows, rounding, overnight) and a rotating roster, then reconciles each hr.attendance punch against its scheduled shift to flag late / early / missing-punch exceptions (stored, payroll-consumable). Provides audited attendance corrections that preserve the original punches and maker-checker overtime and correction approvals gated to HR Managers. Extends the hr anchor without migrating its tables; navigated under the single HR app.
author: Nexa
